hero.badge: File / GitHub → LLM → dataset pipeline, open-source
hero.title: Clean Q/A datasets,
hero.titleMuted: straight from your files and repos.
hero.lead: Mine files and GitHub repos, generate context-aware question-answer pairs with an LLM, catch duplicates, and export to JSONL or CSV — all from a single interface.

terminal.comment: # Run the pipeline on a source

features.title: The whole pipeline, without gluing scripts together.
features.lead: Each step is a module: ingestion, LLM client, data manager, export. Compose them from the UI or the REST API.

ingestion.title: Multi-source ingestion
ingestion.description: File upload (PDF/image, read by your LLM) or a GitHub account's public docs.

generation.title: LLM Q/A generation
generation.description: Configurable prompts, your choice of models, and question-answer pairs grounded in the source.

duplicates.title: Duplicate detection
duplicates.description: Semantic similarity filters out redundancy before pairs reach your dataset.

languages.title: Multi-language
languages.description: Generation in French, English, Spanish and German, with localized prompts.

quality.title: Quality control
quality.description: Automatic validation and filtering, quality scores and configurable thresholds.

api.title: REST API
api.description: Programmatic access to embed generation into your own workflows.

workflow.title: Six steps, from raw page to versioned dataset.

keys.title: Your keys
